question: the 3-year expanding-window grid scored pooled OOS IC ~ -0.01 where the 1-year v1 scored +0.007 — is that the extra history hurting, or a different OOS window?
method: identical purged walk-forward validation folds (13 folds, ~406k pooled OOS rows), identical params (lr=0.1, depth=6, seed 42), only the per-fold training window varies
conclusion: monotone in recency on every metric — stale history actively hurts; non-stationarity dominates. Deployed mode: rolling 250 sessions (train.py --train-window-sessions 250), for uk-eu too (no separate study; documented inheritance).
caveat: mode chosen across 3 candidates on the same OOS folds — mild selection pressure, same order of magnitude as the 6-combo hyperparameter grid.
reproduce: scratch script over trading_bot.ml.train.run_walk_forward(grid=[(0.1, 6)], train_window_sessions=N) for N in {0, 500, 250}
